title: A crossing into PROVEME refuses while either tree carries uncommitted changes
intention: A forward crossing into PROVEME refuses while the build_inspector's working_tree_clean sieve finds any uncommitted change in either tree, so a proof is never taken over another ticket's loose work.
why: Ruling 8x (Akien, verbatim: "yes to all."), item 3e, under 8w ("yes, rework them that way. and cc++") and F11 ("that all sounds good :)"), /home/akien/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md. The /sail sweep (92e0d158b1bc) cleans the tree at the start of a voyage, and the build gate checks it at the end, but dirt written after /sail and committed before PROVED (the 8t gap the peer reported) would still be under the proof and seal. Seating the check at PROVEME entry means the proof is never taken over another ticket's loose work.
traces_to: Law 8 and ruling 8t (the proof and seal must not be taken over another ticket's unproved build; PROVEME entry is where the build's proof is named); Law 7 (the dirt is loud at the door); Law 4 (physics at the chokepoint every crossing passes). RULE 1: the seat lives in base and reaches build_inspector only through its declared interface.
how: (a) a new `class WorkingTreeDirtyRed(IllegalTransition)` beside ProofNamedRed in transitions.py. (b) In emit(), directly after the proof-named seat block: `if target == 'PROVEME' and target_idx > wf.cursor:` import working_tree_clean from cairn.machines.build_inspector.inspector, comp_dir = Path(history_path).resolve().parent, findings = working_tree_clean({'component': comp_dir.name}, comp_dir). If findings: raise WorkingTreeDirtyRed with a message listing every path in findings[0]['values']['dirty'] per repo, plus the disposition 'commit it into its ticket, or stash it (python3 -m skills.sail.sweep), then cross again'. Else append to `proved` a lane {'method': 'working_tree_clean', 'about': comp_dir.name, 'expected': True, 'actual': True, ...} in the shape the other seats' lanes use (copy the shape from the proof-named seat's record). (c) The seat runs only when history_path and state_path are given (inside the same branch as the other seats). (d) Proof file cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_proveme_entry_needs_a_clean_tree.py with PROVES keyed on 11cd253f10bc, clauses 1-3, one tooth each; fixtures under scratch_dir; git with `-c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t`; a ticketless crossing (no ticket kwarg) so the BUILDME/proof-named seats record not_checked. PROOF_TIMEOUT_S = 120. Run only via bin/cairn test --netns.
